title: OSF UI View Manifest
description: Web-view metadata for Data/SFSE/Plugins/OSF/UI/views/<mod-id>/<view-name>/manifest.json. Identity is derived from the folders. Unknown properties are ignored for forward compatibility.

mod.description: Optional authoring consistency hint; identity is always derived from the containing folder.

launcher.description: Use true to list this menu in OSF Settings using the mod folder ID and view title. An object opts in with optional overrides. Omit or use false for private and HUD views.

modId.description: Optional OSF Settings mod ID override. Defaults to the containing mod folder name, which must satisfy the same ID rules when used as the default.

modTitle.description: Optional mod display name override. Defaults to the view title.

entry.description: Relative entry HTML path. Absolute paths and '..' components are rejected.

texture.description: World view only: generated named placeholder texture from the World Screens extension tools.

fullscreen.description: World view only: allows Fullscreen interactions (cursor + pause, the page drawn letterboxed over the game, mouse input).

browser.description: Reserved for World Screens' osfui.browser/tv world view. Implies fullscreen and uses chrome as its local entry. Other view IDs are rejected.

chrome.description: Relative local HTML path with no traversal, URL delimiters or percent escapes.

chromeHeight.description: Chrome band height in output pixels; must be less than the view height.

capturesInput.description: Menu-only. HUD views are always passive.

openOnStart.description: Autostart applies only to HUD views.

order.description: HUD paint order within OSF UI's layer band.

debugOnly.description: A debug-only HUD autostarts only when osfui.developerMode is enabled in OSF Settings.
